parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) A sequence has the two steps that you found in the last row of the table. Show that the expression for the n th term gives the correct value for the 3rd term of this sequence. [3]

content.tex: A sequence has the two steps that you found in the last row of the table.
Show that the expression for the \(n\) th term gives the correct value for the 3rd term of this sequence.
The \(n\) th term of a two-step sequence is \(22^{n} -21\) .
